title: cost-optimization: autotune defaults for batching/caching + quant profiles + unit econ tooling
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: reduce per-token unit cost for common inference workloads by surfacing safe defaults and an automated autotune path for batching, KV-prefix caching, and quantization profiles while exposing unit-economics tooling to SREs and product owners. Changes: 1) runtime: introduce AutotuneController that samples traffic-weighted request characteristics and recommends per-route defaults (target batch size distribution, cache TTL and prefix-length heuristics). 2) quant profiles: add model-family quantization presets and dynamic selection logic based on latency and quality SLOs; includes fallback to full-precision variants for tail requests. 3) console/backend: new UnitEconomics API and dashboard panels showing estimated cost-per-token, effective batch utilization, cache hit rate, and simulated savings from profile changes. 4) CLI/tooling: redwood-cli unit-econ estimate subcommand and a small simulation harness to run batch/caching/quant tradeoff experiments locally. 5) tests and evals: new integration tests that validate no-regression on latency p50/p95 and quality evals on a small prompt suite. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind a feature flag, start with internal-prod, then 10% of hosted traffic for 48 hours, evaluate unit-econ metrics and perf regressions, then full rollout. Checklist: - [x] design doc and Linear ticket ENG-1452 - [x] runtime implementation + unit tests - [x] console panels and API - [x] CLI tooling and e2e smoke - [x] perf/regression tests - [x] docs and changelog. Related: builds on prior autotune work in pr-25012 and pr-27412. Impact: estimated 8-14% unit cost savings for chat-style workloads in internal benchmarks without measurable quality regression.

Integration tests and eval harness updates (Riley Zhang)
review_comments: Miguel Torres: Can the sampler guarantee sample representativeness across tenants? Suggest adding weighted tenant sampling to avoid skew.
Asha Patel: Added tenant-weighted sampling and a config knob with sensible default 0.8 to bias toward higher-volume tenants while preserving representation for smaller ones.
Riley Zhang: I see potential p95 regressions when batch sizes increase for short-context requests. Can we add a max-batch-bytes heuristic?
Asha Patel: Implemented max-batch-bytes and a per-route cap; added test that asserts p95 stays within 5% of baseline.
Katherine Moore: Console panel looks great, but can we show simulated savings per model family as well?
Asha Patel: Added model-family breakdown and a quick-sim button that runs the server-side simulation for the past 7 days of metrics.
Miguel Torres: CI flake on test_autotune_integration failing in initial run (timeout). Re-ran and green. Consider increasing timeout in flaky envs.
Riley Zhang: Approve after CI green and one follow-up doc nits fix.
release_notes: Add autotune defaults for batching and caching, dynamic quantization profiles, and unit-economics tooling (dashboard + CLI). Staged rollout behind feature flag. Expected unit-cost savings for chat workloads; no quality regressions in canary.
